items.title: Comcast vs. Walt Disney: Which Media Stock Is a Better Buy?
items.summary: Comcast's cash machine and Disney's prized franchises pull in opposite directions, and the valuation gap between them is hard to ignore.

items.title: 4 High-Yield Dividend Stocks for Retirees Who Want Income They Can Count On
items.summary: Yields above 8% tempt retirees, but the real question is whether the cash behind each check is strong enough to cover it. Four companies tied to tolls, rent, and phone bills face that test, and one carries a tax wrinkle many IRA owners miss.

items.title: 4 Dividend Stocks Yielding Over 4% That Retirees Can Grow Tax-Free in a Roth IRA
items.summary: A $500,000 income portfolio can quietly hand the IRS thousands of dollars every year, and one of these four high-yield payers is far more exposed than the rest. Find out which stock belongs in a Roth first and why the gap compounds.

items.title: The 10-Year Treasury Now Pays 5%. These 3 Dividend Stocks Still Pay More
items.summary: A Treasury coupon locked in for a decade sets a new bar for income investors, and dividends can be cut when cash runs short. Three NYSE payers clear it, but one holds only a razor-thin lead that rising yields could erase.

items.title: An $850,000 Portfolio in Verizon, NNN REIT and Enterprise Products Pays $52,395 a Year in Dividends. Here’s What Happens if One Cuts
items.summary: Key TakeawaysA hypothetical $850,000 portfolio split evenly across Verizon, NNN REIT and Enterprise Products Partners pays about $4,370 a month in dividends at today’s prices. All three dividends look safe, and Enterprise’s is the best covered and the fastest growing.

items.title: Verizon Pays Out $11.7 Billion a Year in Dividends. Here’s the Free Cash Flow Math Behind Its 6.2%-Yielding Payout.
items.summary: Verizon is a cash flow machine.

items.title: Musk Says AT&T and Verizon May “Lose Some Revenue” as Starlink’s Phone Service Gets 40x the Bandwidth
items.summary: Key TakeawaysElon Musk said SpaceX’s next direct-to-cell satellites, launching in 2027, will have 40x the bandwidth, and AT&T and Verizon may lose some revenue. The hit looks small for now, since satellite signals struggle to reach phones indoors, but SpaceX’s planned rooftop micro cell towers aim at that gap.

items.title: 3 High-Yield Dividend Stocks to Buy Now and 2 to Avoid Despite the Yield
items.summary: Among high-yield dividend stocks, there are some diamonds in the rough, but beware of the "yield traps" as well.
